title: 5 day program pt 2
author: Ariadne
desc: **5 Day Program Pt 2** is a comprehensive 6-week workout plan designed for those looking to enhance their strength and conditioning through targeted training. Comprising four distinct workout days each week, this program focuses on building muscle and improving overall fitness with a mix of compound and isolation exercises. Each session includes a variety of movements, such as the Romanian Deadlift, Lat Pulldown, and Kettlebell Swing, ensuring a well-rounded approach to strength training. Get ready to push your limits and achieve your fitness goals with this structured and effective program!

ex.note: Can substitute for another leg press like machine: belt squat, V – squat, leg press, or Smith machine
10 reps up and 10 reps down turf
Can substitute for wide stance goblet squat, keep torso upright, moderate weight, slow reps,squeeze the ground away from you
1x full turf = 1 rep , up and down full turf =2 reps , keep track of weight used
Warm up pace
Keep torso engaged and steady. Wide or neutral stand with feet, you should feel this in your core and triceps
Press through mid chest not upper shoulders , elbows down
Standing or seated
Elbows should not move, keep them tucked by your side. Only forearms are pushing down. You will fill this in your triceps. ￼
Let your legs down slow and controlled, squeeze and engage your core through the entire exercise

Neutral feet. Push-ups back while keeping the weights close to your body the entire time and your back is flat and straight to come up. You want to push through your big toe and heal at the same time.
Neutral, spine + engaged core.  only use your glutes with this one keeping your chin tucked forward will help. think pushing back into your hips and glutes. Think of a scooping motion to come up
Slow + controlled. Go heavier than you want to. Think sitting back into it. keep chest leaned forward. Eyes on the ground in front of you and push through your front foot’s heel and big toe
you can substitute for clam shells using a 25 pound plate while standing or laying on the ground or do glute kickbacks using a cable machine. ￼
Engage your core and push through your glutes to snap forward
Keep your pinkies engaged to this movement. It’s gonna help with lot recruitment. Make sure you feel this in your back and not your arms. Think about breaking the bar in front of you as you pull down
Slow in controlled movement squeeze to engage your mid back, pulling the cable towards your belly button with your elbows tucked by your sides
Pause at the top you want to feel this in the back of your shoulders not your neck
Slow and controlled no swinging
Minimal rest between these two sets
Zone two is a heart rate that you will bring yourself to during this exercise which means you should be able to hold a conversation and talk in full sentences while working out
Warm-up speed
